units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 795:2">Yalk. Deut. 795</cite> (play on <he>הדברים</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 1:1">Deut. I, 1</cite>) <he>מה הד׳ הזו בניה מתנהגין וכ׳</he> as the bee is followed by the young, so are the Israelites led by the righteous &c.; (<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1:6">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> <he>כדְּבוֹרִים היו וכ׳</he> like bees my children were guided &c.).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מה הד׳ הזו וכ׳</he> as the bee whose honey &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דְּבוֹרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:7">Kel. XVI, 7</cite> <he>מדף של ד׳</he> the vessel used for smoking the bees out.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 7b:8">Bekh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>דבש ד׳</he> bee-honey. Deut. R. l. c., v. supra.

senses.gloss: pr. n. f. Deborah, the heroine and prophetess.
